svg.title: Light use efficiency (GPP / PAR) from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a first silage cut, as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest: 3 cuts in a dry month (SPI-1 ≤ −1.5) and 7 cuts in a normal month; mean and bootstrap 95 % CI over the episodes.
svg.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: LUE = GPP / PAR as a fraction of the LUE of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −0.50 to 2.00; thin lines mark 1 and 0, an orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest). Markers every 7 days. Lines: normal group steel blue, solid, with circles; dry group vermillion, dashed, with squares. The band around each line is the bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean over the episodes, drawn where 3 or more episodes have a value; the line is drawn where 2 or more have a value. Dry episodes: qvidja-2019-06-11, qvidja-2022-06-21, qvidja-2023-06-19. Normal episodes: anttila-2022-06-21, anttila-2023-06-21, qvidja-2018-06-12, qvidja-2021-06-14, qvidja-2024-06-15, sarkisuo-2022-06-30, viikki-2022-07-01. Days +1 to +14: relative LUE dry 0.64 (95 % CI 0.30 to 0.82, n 3), normal 0.51 (95 % CI 0.41 to 0.59, n 7); difference dry − normal 0.13 (95 % CI −0.19 to 0.36), exact permutation p = 0.31 (120 splits). Days +15 to +28: relative LUE dry 0.97 (95 % CI 0.52 to 1.30, n 3), normal 1.13 (95 % CI 0.82 to 1.39, n 6); difference dry − normal −0.16 (95 % CI −0.63 to 0.31), exact permutation p = 0.62 (84 splits).
